features.description: Thread chain_id and stage_id from eval_benchmark.go through MultiExecutorConfig into executor.Task.Metadata, so BuildResourceAttributes picks them up and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES carries them to the opencode subprocess. The OTLP receiver already extracts ailang.chain_id/stage_id from resource attrs and stores on spans, so this single plumbing change closes the gap that left ailang chains live with '(no spans yet)' for active chains.
acceptance_criteria: Add ChainID and StageID fields to MultiExecutorConfig struct in internal/eval_harness/agent_runner_multi.go
Build executor.Task with Metadata{chain_id, stage_id} populated only when non-empty
cmd/ailang/eval_benchmark.go sets multiConfig.ChainID = evalChain.ChainID and multiConfig.StageID = stageID before calling RunAgentBenchmarkWithExecutor (guarded by non-nil chain + non-empty stageID)
New regression test TestRunAgentBenchmark_PopulatesChainStageMetadata uses a stub executor that captures Task.Metadata and asserts chain_id and stage_id flow through
features.notes: Plumbed chain_id+stage_id from eval_benchmark.go through MultiExecutorConfig (new fields) into executor.Task.Metadata via buildChainMetadata helper. 4 sub-tests pass (TestBuildChainMetadata_PopulatesBothWhenSet + TestBuildChainMetadata_OmitsEmpty 3 cases). No regression in eval_harness, observatory, cmd/ailang.

features.description: Manual verification that the plumbing actually closes the gap: a fresh smoke-mode eval run with OTLP enabled writes spans with non-NULL chain_id/stage_id, ailang chains live shows live per-stage progress instead of '(no spans yet)', and the CHANGELOG entry is added under v0.22.0 alongside M-EVAL-LOCAL-OBSERVABILITY.
acceptance_criteria: Rebuild ailang via make quick-install with the M1 change applied
Restart ailang server to pick up the new binary
Run a single fizzbuzz benchmark with OTLP_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:1957 and -agent
Query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spans WHERE chain_id IS NOT NULL — returns > 0
Query: SELECT DISTINCT chain_id, stage_id FROM spans WHERE stage_id IS NOT NULL — shows the test chain and its stage
ailang chains live <test-chain-id> --once shows real 'X s ago' last-span values (not '(no spans yet)')
Add CHANGELOG entry under the existing M-EVAL-LOCAL-OBSERVABILITY block in changelogs/v0.10-current.md noting the followup landed
Move design doc + sprint plan from planned/v0_22_0/ to implemented/v0_22_0/ via finalize_sprint.sh
features.notes: End-to-end verified with fizzbuzz benchmark: 286 spans with non-NULL chain_id+stage_id linking back to chain 6a82fab9-... and stage e984daaf-... Also discovered + fixed SQL bug: MAX(TIMESTAMP) returns raw string, scan into sql.NullString and parse manually. ailang chains live now shows real Last-span ages (3m37s ago) instead of (no spans yet). CHANGELOG entry updated.
